% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpAnimation[in=fadeIn,trigger=load,duration=800ms]{
  \wcTpBox{Animated content}
}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/animation/animation.js";
import "/components/box/box.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-animation");
element1.setAttribute("in", "fadeIn");
element1.setAttribute("trigger", "load");
element1.setAttribute("duration", "800ms");
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n    "));

const element2 = document.createElement("tp-box");
element2.append(document.createTextNode("Animated content"));
element1.append(element2);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}
